meta.notes: no actions at all and no segment: unadjusted-in-fact + as-of-today. Decimals are strings; dates are ISO days; enums are their values; polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}. Prices: open/close are the adjusted series (house rule 6), price_open/price_close the raw print, read only when price_only is true. Config is BacktestConfig.model_dump(mode='json'). A raised engine error is {error: {type, message}}. Synthetic seeded fixtures (weekday calendar from 2024-01-01, holidays 2024-01-26 and 2024-03-25). Regenerate with `.venv/bin/python ../tools/parity/golden_backtest.py` from decile-blueprint; each case is computed from its stored inputs.

output: No corporate actions are on record, so the prices adjusted here are unadjusted in fact. Any split or bonus reads as a price move.
Prices are adjusted as of the day this ran, not as of each simulated day, so a corporate action is reflected in bars that predate it.
